import convert_masks as cm, cv2, numpy as np, pandas as pd
p=cm.load_model('mobile_sam.pt'); img=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB); p.set_image(img)
d=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
for i in [0,6,5,14]:
    r=d.iloc[i]; b=np.array([r.xmin,r.ymin,r.xmax,r.ymax],np.float32)
    m,s,_=p.predict(box=b,multimask_output=True)
    ba=(r.xmax-r.xmin+1)*(r.ymax-r.ymin+1)
    print(i,r.type,[(round(float(x),3),int(mm.sum()),round(mm[r.ymin:r.ymax+1,r.xmin:r.xmax+1].sum()/ba,2)) for x,mm in zip(s,m)])
EOF
